mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pwork WHERE pid=#{pid} AND wstatus='展示')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c JOIN pwork p ON p.pid=c.pid WHERE c.pid=#{pid} AND p.wstatus='展示'

SELECT c.pid,c.cid,c.uid,c.comcontent, DATE_FORMAT(c.comct,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS createdAt, u.uname AS nickname,u.avatar FROM comment c JOIN pwork p ON p.pid=c.pid LEFT JOIN user u ON u.uid=c.uid WHERE c.pid=#{pid} AND p.wstatus='展示' ORDER BY c.comct DESC,c.cid ASC,c.uid ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (pid,cid,uid,comcontent) SELECT pid,#{cid},#{uid},#{content} FROM pwork WHERE pid=#{pid} AND wstatus='展示'
mapper.select: SELECT pid,cid,uid FROM comment WHERE cid=#{cid}
mapper.delete: DELETE c FROM comment c JOIN pwork p ON p.pid=c.pid WHERE c.pid=#{pid} AND c.cid=#{cid} AND c.uid=#{uid} AND p.wstatus='展示'
